title: Compute a Git blob SHA
description: This function reproduces Git's blob hash by hashing its byte-length header and content together.

steps.description: The code uses hashlib to reproduce git hash-object's blob hashing.
git_blob_sha encodes the content as UTF-8 bytes, builds Git's blob header from the byte length, and hashes header plus content.

steps.question: Will the Git blob SHA and the plain SHA-1 of the note match?
steps.answer: No. The Git blob SHA includes the blob header before it hashes the content.

steps.description: The first print shows the blob SHA for the note.
The second print shows a different plain SHA-1, labeled wrong for Git.
The multi-byte example prints 10 bytes and 7 characters, showing why the header uses byte length.
